title: PrestaShop Multistore
meta: Several shops, languages and currencies run from one PrestaShop back office, planned and set up. From $400, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Run several shops from one PrestaShop back office
overview: PrestaShop has a built in multistore feature, and we set it up properly. We plan which settings, products and stock are shared and which stay separate, then configure each shop with its own domain, language, currency and theme. We add shop specific tax and shipping rules and check how orders and customers behave across shops. You get a working structure on staging, and written notes your team can follow.

faq: Is multistore better than separate installs?
It depends. One back office saves time when shops share products and staff. Separate installs suit shops with very different catalogs. We explain this in the plan and suggest what fits.
Each shop domain must point to the same install, and your host must allow this. We check your hosting first and tell you if a change is needed.
We set up the language system and load translations you supply. Writing the translated text is your side, or a translator's. We can import it from a sheet.
Will modules work in every shop?
Most do, but some are not multistore aware. We test your key modules in each shop and flag any that need replacing before launch.
